qa_pairs.question: Which component uses the 1AZ specification in the transmission shafts section?
qa_pairs.answer: Output flange collar nut installed with bolt cement

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference between initial and final torque for the output flange collar nut?
qa_pairs.answer: 70 Nm (190 Nm initial minus 120 Nm final)

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection covers these transmission shaft specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23-7 Manual transmission, subsection 23 21 Transmission Shafts
